notes:
vekstio is an underwriting workspace for multifamily investors. Drop the offering memorandum, the T12 and the rent roll. It maps every line, rebuilds the model, flags what the seller left out and shows the price the deal supports, the questions to ask the broker, and a letter of intent ready to send.

Every figure is computed by a deterministic engine: the same inputs always give the same result. Each number shows where it came from: the document line, your own entry, or a default you have not confirmed yet. The AI reads and explains. It does not generate the numbers.

Your files and deals are private to your workspace. They are never used to train AI, and we never sell data.

Your first deal is free.

vekstio is an educational underwriting tool. It is not investment, tax, legal or lending advice.
